title: Chapter 175: The Military Advisor
content:
Chapter 175: The Military Advisor

Wang Shuo returned to Wana Village and saw that the territory was building infrastructure again.

The population of the territory had skyrocketed, and many facilities were not enough, such as toilets.

"Hello, Lord!"

"Hello, Lord!"

Along the way, the people who saw Wang Shuo greeted him enthusiastically.

At first, it was only the people who had experienced the period when the beasts surrounded the village. Later, other people were also infected and looked at this lord curiously.

"Hello!" Wang Shuo watched these people, both familiar and unfamiliar, return the greetings one by one, and even occasionally chatted with them.

Wang Shuo actually didn't like this kind of scene, but there was no way. For the sake of people's hearts and loyalty, he could only do this.

When he returned to the lord's mansion, Wang Shuo seemed to be exhausted.

"Boss!" Duan Wenxi also ran over happily.

"Don't you have anything to do?" Seeing his smiling face, Wang Shuo glared at him.

"Boss, I'm here to greet you!"

"If you have something to say, say it now! If you have something to say, say it now!" Wang Shuo glared at him and cursed him with a smile.

Duan Wenxi smiled mysteriously, and then said: "Boss, I found many minerals outside our territory, and there is a particularly large iron mine. According to Mira, this is a second-level iron mine."

Wang Shuo was startled and showed a puzzled look: "Second-level iron mine?"

"Yes, it is the kind of iron mine with a large output and high quality."

Duan Wenxi explained: "Mira has been stationed in the iron mine and is laying eggs to hatch gold-eating demon insects."

"Does she need anything else?" Wang Shuo pondered.

"Well, he needs energy crystals and soul crystals."

Wang Shuo didn't want to care about this matter anymore, waved his hand, and said: "You are fully responsible for this matter. You provide whatever he needs, and make sure to ensure the mining of iron ore."

"Yes, boss, there is another thing I want to report to you, that is, there is a special professional talent in our territory, I believe the boss will like it."

"Uh? Tell me." Wang Shuo became interested.

"I will bring the person directly here!" Duan Wenxi walked to the door of the lord's mansion and brought in a handsome middle-aged man.

"I am Zou Yuanjie, and I meet the lord." Zou Yuanjie saluted to Wang Shuo, leaning forward slightly, neither humble nor arrogant.

He tried his best to pretend that nothing had happened, hoping to be appreciated by Wang Shuo.

He was captured from the bandit camp, and his background was not good, and he was powerless. If he didn't get the appreciation of the lord, his profession would be ruined.

Wana Village has implemented private ownership. Housing and food require money. The captives have had their property confiscated. If they don't have a job, they can't even afford food in Wana Village.

And he can't do any other work except the profession of "military advisor".

After all, it's impossible to work.

Even if he wants to work, he can only work for the lord with wisdom.

Wang Shuo looked at this man. His long gown was a little worn and even a little dirty.

"No need to be polite!"

Wang Shuo looked at him carefully again. He saw that he had high cheekbones, thin cheeks, pale face, bright eyes, and a calm face, but his breathing was not very even. His hands drooped naturally, and he didn't know where to put them.

"I heard that your profession is a military advisor?" Wang Shuo looked at him in confusion, his eyes were very curious.

Wang Shuo was naturally very interested in this profession.

"My Lord, yes." Zou Yuanjie bowed again, with a hint of pride in his words.

"At present, I only have one skill that can boost morale." As he said that, he showed Wang Shuo his skill attributes.

[High morale: Increase the morale of your own troops (1,000 people) by 10 points, 10% attack damage, lasting for 1 hour, can be upgraded. ]

Oh my god, this...

This is to increase the temporary buff. If the buff level is high enough and the number of your own troops is large enough, the total attack power will be considerable!

He has found a treasure, and who knows, he will comprehend some other skills in the future.

Wang Shuo was overjoyed. This is a talent worth cultivating.
